minutes.headline: Appointing committee voted to appoint Anna Lockwood and Michael Rup to the Finance Committee, terms to June 30, 2027.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee Appointing Committee voted to appoint two candidates to the Finance Committee, with terms running to June 30, 2027; a roll call followed.
Two candidates were interviewed for two vacancies; a third candidate did not appear and another asked to be withdrawn, which the committee agreed to respect.
Members said the budget is running behind its usual timing because of a new town manager, with the crunch running from late January through Town Meeting.
A member said last year had many extra meetings because of the override and that this year has similar pressures.
The new appointees are to be sworn in at the town clerk's office, and the chair will email them about the next meeting.

why_it_matters: Both vacancies on the Finance Committee are now filled, so the body that reviews the budget and makes recommendations at Town Meeting has its full membership going into the budget season.
The committee's workload this year depends on a budget that is arriving later than usual, which compresses the time available to review it before Town Meeting.
